## Wave 7 Summary

Wave 7 executes the off-session Riemann-Hypothesis / trace-formula exploration (`computations/offsession-riemann/rh-conversation-transcript.md` + `connes-ncg-theorist-review.md`) as six pre-registered gates. The off-session finding — the substrate is a **trace formula whose geometric (length-spectrum) side has never been computed**, and whose spectral zeta scatters its zeros off any critical line because the Weyl-chamber + Peter–Weyl projection destroys the Euler product — is converted from from-memory structural assertion to measurement. The wave splits into two coupled tracks. **Geometric-side track (W7-1 → W7-2 → W7-3/W7-4)**: anchor an exact two-sided trace formula on the undeformed group (W7-1, positive control), extract the substrate's length/action spectrum at τ_fold for the FIRST time (W7-2), predict it from the integrable Euler–Arnold frequency map (Berry–Tabor, W7-3), and certify its arithmetic structure (squared-action commensurability, W7-4). **Zeta-zero geography track (W7-5, W7-6)**: locate the zeros of the actual Jensen-deformed ζ_{D_K} (W7-5, expected FAIL — the genuine SU(3) object), and characterize the asymptotic zero distribution of the exactly-solvable S³ proxy F(s) beyond the certified window (W7-6, INFO-class). The wave is the substrate-IS reading of the wave-trace: closed-geodesic lengths are the periodic internal relay orbits of the fabric; the oscillatory remainder of the spectral action beyond all Seeley–DeWitt terms localizes on them by Poisson summation.

Carry-forward source: the off-session transcript (Legs 0–2 → W7-1/W7-2/W7-3) and the Connes review §V (V.1 → W7-5, V.2 → W7-4, V.3 → W7-6). No prior S105 corpus item touches a trace formula, length spectrum, or zeta-zeros — no dedup collisions. W7 is mutually independent of W1–W6: the only shared input is `s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz`, consumed READ-ONLY (also read by W5-1; no verdict dependency, no pin conflict).

**Prior-art anchors (NOT re-derived; cited as cross-checks)**:
- `computations/session-54/s54_gutzwiller_su3.py` (GUTZWILLER-SU3-54, S54 PASS): established Manakov integrability of the Jensen Euler–Arnold flow on (SU(3), g_τ) ⇒ Gutzwiller isolated-orbit form structurally inapplicable (det(M−I)=0 by theorem) ⇒ the **Berry–Tabor** form is the applicable trace formula. Re-aimed by W7-3.
- `computations/session-61/s61_trace_formula_geometric.py` (FORMULA-61, T3-batch INFO): the prior geometric-side trace formula attempt; W7-2's heat-trace pipeline supersedes it at higher dynamic range (155,984 eigenvalues with multiplicity vs S61's 992-mode residual).
- `computations/offsession-riemann/_rh_substrate_sanity.py`: the certified argument-principle winding kernel (`winding_count` / `_int_winding` / `_isolate` / `_polish` / `find_zeros`); the **dense-perimeter pre-sampling fix is MANDATORY** (corner-only sampling aliases 2π wraps; the Riemann control returning 0 zeros in a window provably containing 5 is the documented catch). Reused by W7-1 / W7-5 / W7-6.

## Wave 7 Decision Point Prerequisites

No upstream-verdict prerequisites from S104 or prior S105 waves gate W7 dispatch. **Intra-wave** sequencing only:

- **W7-1** is unconditional (positive control; no gate dependency).
- **W7-2** is unconditional (reads the s84 cache READ-ONLY). Its output `.npz` is FORWARD-PINNED intra-session to W7-3 and W7-4.
- **W7-3** is GATED on `S105-W7-2-LENGTH-SPECTRUM-FT` **non-FAIL** (PASS or INFO). On W7-2 FAIL, W7-3 honestly closes per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (PRE-REG-INC blocked by upstream FAIL; value=`upstream_W7-2_FAIL`).
- **W7-4** is GATED on `S105-W7-2-LENGTH-SPECTRUM-FT` **non-FAIL** (same closure on W7-2 FAIL).
- **W7-5**, **W7-6** are unconditional (W7-5 reads the s84 cache; W7-6 reads no cache).

The intra-wave forward-pin (W7-2 → W7-3/W7-4) is the documented benign signature for `_plan_upstream_pin_validator.py`: exit-1 with `n_mismatches: 0, n_missing_npz ≥ 1` on `s105_*` slugs (the npz does not exist at plan-freeze; it is produced by W7-2 at runtime). Disposition (b) per `/rclab-plan` skill Phase 3a — annotated inline at the affected `input_files` pins below.

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the geometric-side theta-dual sum equals the spectral-side Peter–Weyl heat trace
            at τ=0 to < 1e-10, with c_off > 0 the spin-connection floor."
    Step 1: C₂(p,q) = (p² + q² + pq + 3p + 3q)/3          [canonical casimir_pq; SU(3) normalization]
    Step 2: |λ(p,q)|² = C₂(p,q) + c_off                    [bi-invariant Dirac square; Parthasarathy/Lichnerowicz form

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The substrate's τ=0 trace formula is two-sided exact (< 1e-10): the spectral Peter–Weyl
  sum and the geometric coroot-lattice theta-dual agree. The wave's pipeline is validated
  on a known-exact case — any oscillatory structure W7-2 later extracts at τ_fold is a real
  geometric-side length spectrum, not a pipeline artifact. This is the positive control.
FAIL_meaning: >
  Two-sided mismatch > 1e-10 at some pinned heat-time. Indicates either a wrong c_off, a
  wrong Weyl-denominator Jacobian in the Poisson dual, or a truncation-radius bug. The wave's
  pipeline is NOT validated; W7-2 results would be uninterpretable. Routes to in-session fix
  (the dual derivation is the suspect — re-derive the rank-2 Poisson Jacobian).
INFO_meaning: >
  A documented conditional-convergence edge case (e.g. the smallest heat-time t=0.02 needs a
  larger truncation radius than budgeted, leaving a tail above 1e-10 but below 1e-6 with the
  residual provably decreasing in radius). The identity holds; the numerics are radius-limited.

# ---- Effort + framing ----

  files_created:

    - "computations/session-105/s105_w7_1_trace_formula_exact_anchor.npz"
    - "computations/session-105/s105_w7_1_trace_formula_exact_anchor.png"
  estimated_time: "0.5–1 gate-slot (~3–5 hours; the in-script rank-2 Poisson derivation is the cost)"

substrate_framing: |
  GEOMETRIC. The fabric's internal geometry at τ=0 is the bi-invariant SU(3) spectral triple.
  The heat trace K(t)=Tr exp(−t D_K²) is the substrate's own return-probability functional;
  its spectral side IS the Peter–Weyl decomposition of D_K's eigenvalue spectrum (the set of

  physical fabric is at τ_fold=0.190 (W7-2). The arrow is D_K eigenvalues → heat trace →
  two-sided trace identity; the geometric side is derived FROM the spectrum, never assumed.

    N_smooth(λ) via the canonical a_n^{ζ} Seeley–DeWitt coefficients (a_0_FW_zeta..a_8_FW_zeta;
    regulator-pin tagged) OR an in-script Weyl polynomial fit over a pinned quantile window

    residual ρ_osc(λ) = ρ(λ) − ρ_smooth(λ). (4) Apply a Gaussian window of pinned width, then FFT
    over the conjugate (length) variable. The geometric-side length appears as L_γ = 2π·(FFT
    frequency in the λ-variable); peak table {L_γ, amplitude}. (5) Resolution budget δL ≈ 2π/λ_max
    declared in-block. (6) τ=0 synthetic control: feed the W7-1 τ=0 closed spectrum through the
    IDENTICAL pipeline; verify the peaks land on the W7-1 coroot lattice (pipeline-correctness check).
  producing_script: "computations/session-105/s105_w7_2_length_spectrum_ft.py"

# ---- PRDR Checklist (8 items) ----
operator:
  type: "set"
  form: "{ L_γ : SNR(L_γ) >= snr_thresh AND |ΔL_γ|_window-halving <= δL } with cardinality >= 3"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "n_stable_peaks >= 3 (each with SNR >= 6.0 above the smooth-subtraction residual floor AND window-halving position drift <= δL) AND τ=0 control peaks on the W7-1 lattice within δL"
  direction: ">="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: false
  proof_ref: >
    null — the peak count is a numerical output of the FFT pipeline, not an analytically reachable
    boundary. The SNR floor (6.0) and the resolution budget δL=2π/λ_max are fixed at plan-freeze;
    the number of peaks clearing them is measured. (Non-numerical-threshold field per the R3 NON-COMPUTE
    note: the real PASS criterion is the set-cardinality + stability conjunction in `operator`.)

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: false
  mesh_density: "continuous (FFT frequency grid); peak positions L_γ are continuous, not a rational mesh"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "all non-zero-mode eigenvalues in the L=12 cache (166,896 block-level entries; Peter–Weyl weight expands to the full L² multiplicity)"
  L_max: "12 (the s84 cache ceiling; READ-ONLY)"
  scan_range: "λ-window for the smooth fit: 20th–70th percentile quantile band (interior; avoids IR floor + L_max truncation bend)"
  step_size: "FFT grid: 2048-point uniform λ-grid over [λ_min, λ_max] (matches the s104 log-periodic pipeline grid resolution)"
  tolerance: "δL = 2π/λ_max (resolution budget; window-halving position drift must be <= this); SNR floor = 6.0"
  scheme: "STRUTINSKY-WEYL-SUBTRACT"
  convention: "PRIMARY counting = Peter–Weyl dim-weighted (full L² regular-representation trace; Weyl exponent ≈8, the d=8 dimension-spectrum reading). DIAGNOSTIC counting = block-level (Weyl exponent ≈5, the per-sector reading). The PRIMARY choice selects the FULL-L² trace formula whose geometric side is the coroot lattice (matching W7-1); the block-level diagnostic is reported but NOT the PASS basis. This is the load-bearing counting-choice pin: the two Weyl exponents ≈5 vs ≈8 are documented in the off-session transcript (block-reduced N~λ^5.022; PW-weighted N~λ^7.817)."
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "torch.fft for the FFT (length-spectrum transform); torch.linalg if any matrix op; numpy for cache I/O"
  # CONDITIONAL pins:
  regulator_pin: "a_n^{ζ}"   # the smooth Seeley–DeWitt part cites a_0_FW_zeta..a_8_FW_zeta (zeta-regulated); MANDATORY per regulator-pin-discipline.md
  window_function: "Gaussian (Strutinsky standard); width = 3× mean level spacing in the quantile band (matches s54/s104 Strutinsky γ convention)"
  window_halving_crosscheck: "re-run the FT with window width halved (1.5× mean spacing); a true geometric peak is window-width-stable, a smoothing artifact moves"
  # NO CLASS pin: no SCHEMATIC helper (canonical a_n^{ζ} + in-script Weyl fit).

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the PRIMARY (Peter–Weyl dim-weighted) counting selects the d=8 Weyl exponent, whose
            geometric-side length spectrum is the coroot lattice; the block-level diagnostic selects
            the per-sector exponent ≈5; the PRIMARY is the correct trace-formula basis."
    Step 1: ρ_smooth^{PW}(λ) ~ d/dλ [ c·λ^d ]  with d=8  [Weyl law on the d=8 internal manifold;

## §W7-4. S105-W7-4-GEODESIC-COMMENSURABILITY

# ---- Identity ----

  description: >
    (1) Collect the squared lengths {L_γ²} from W7-2 (measured) and W7-3 (predicted), plus the W7-1 τ=0
    coroot-lattice squared lengths as a positive control. (2) For each pair, form the ratio r_ij = L_i²/L_j²
    and run Sage PSLQ (or continued-fraction rational recovery) at the pinned precision to recover a rational
    p/q within tolerance. (3) PASS iff a pre-registered minimum fraction of pairwise squared-ratios recover a
    rational p/q with bounded denominator within tolerance, AND the τ=0 control recovers exact rationals
    (the coroot lattice is a quadratic-form lattice by construction — squared lengths are integers·(lattice
    scale), so ratios are exactly rational). (4) A FAIL (incommensurable squared spectrum) is SURPRISING and
    routes to a Q1 workshop (decision-point block, NOT the rubric).

  type: "ratio"
  form: "frac{ pairs (i,j) : PSLQ-recovers rational p/q for L_i²/L_j² with denom<=Q_max within tol } >= rational_frac"

strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: "rational_frac = 0.80 (>=80% of pairwise SQUARED-length ratios recover a rational p/q with denominator <= Q_max=64 within rel_tol=1e-6) AND the τ=0 control recovers exact rationals (rel_tol=1e-9) on all pairs"
  direction: ">="

boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    For the τ=0 control the boundary IS analytically reachable: the coroot lattice is a quadratic-form
    lattice, so |λ|²=C₂+c_off takes values on an integer mesh and squared-length ratios are exactly rational
    (recovered at rel_tol=1e-9). For the τ_fold measured/predicted spectra, rationality is the HYPOTHESIS
    being tested (the deformed flow may or may not preserve commensurability) — the PASS boundary 0.80 is
    fixed at plan-freeze; the realized fraction is measured. PSLQ precision is the discriminator.

reachable_rationals:
  includes_integer_mesh: true
  mesh_density: "PSLQ searches the rational mesh {p/q : 1<=q<=Q_max=64}; the τ=0 control lattice is an exact integer quadratic-form mesh"

machinery_pin_map:
  N_eval: "all unordered pairs (i,j) of squared lengths from the combined W7-2 + W7-3 stable-peak set; plus all W7-1 τ=0 control pairs"
  L_max: "12 (inherited from W7-2/W7-3 via their length spectra)"
  scan_range: "PSLQ denominator bound Q_max = 64; rational recovery over p/q with 1<=q<=64"
  step_size: "N/A — exact rational recovery per pair, not a scan"
  tolerance: "rel_tol = 1e-6 for τ_fold pairs (PSLQ rational match); rel_tol = 1e-9 for the τ=0 control pairs; min stable peak count = 3 per spectrum (else INFO)"
  scheme: "PSLQ-SQUARED-RATIO"
  convention: "SQUARED-length ratios (the criterion is PRE-FIXED to L² — NOT raw L). Structural reason: on the undeformed group the geodesic lengths are L ∝ √(integer) (quadratic-form lattice ⇒ |λ|²∝integer ⇒ L∝√integer), so raw ratios L_i/L_j = √(n_i/n_j) are √rational, NOT rational — a raw-length PSLQ test FAILS τ=0 by construction. Squaring restores rationality: L_i²/L_j² = n_i/n_j ∈ ℚ. This fix is pre-registered HERE, before compute (it corrects the review-V.2 draft criterion which, as written on raw lengths, would falsely FAIL the undeformed group)."
  random_seed: "N/A — deterministic"
  GPU_path: "cpu-cap-OMP8 (Sage MCP PSLQ / mpmath continued fractions; arbitrary-precision, CPU)"
  # CONDITIONAL pins:
  publication_precision: "N/A — verdict is a rationality fraction + per-pair p/q table, not a single downstream anchor"
  # NO regulator_pin: squared lengths from the metric/FT, not a regulated a_n.
  # NO CLASS pin: no SCHEMATIC helper (Sage PSLQ first-principles).

audit_discriminators:
  audit_sha256_inputs: ["script", "canonical", "pinmap"]
  content_sha256_inputs: ["script"]

substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "the rationality criterion must be on SQUARED lengths; raw-length ratios are √rational at τ=0
            and would falsely FAIL the undeformed group."
    Step 1: τ=0 closed geodesic on bi-invariant SU(3): the length-squared of a closed geodesic in the
            coroot lattice direction ν is L_ν² = (const)·⟨ν,ν⟩, and ⟨ν,ν⟩ ∈ ℤ·(lattice scale)
            [quadratic-form lattice; the coroot lattice is integral]
    Step 2: ⇒ L_ν² = c·n_ν with n_ν ∈ ℤ   ⇒   L_ν²/L_μ² = n_ν/n_μ ∈ ℚ   [squared ratios are rational]
    Step 3: but L_ν/L_μ = √(n_ν/n_μ)   [raw ratios are √rational, generically IRRATIONAL — e.g. √2]
    Step 4: ⇒ a PSLQ rationality test on RAW lengths returns "irrational" for √2-type ratios and FAILS
            the undeformed group by construction; a PSLQ test on SQUARED lengths returns n_ν/n_μ ∈ ℚ and
            correctly certifies the τ=0 lattice as commensurable.

            L3=e^{τ}); whether the deformed squared-length spectrum remains on a single quadratic-form
            lattice (squared ratios still rational) is the HYPOTHESIS under test.
    Direction: more pairwise squared-ratios recovering rational p/q (bounded denominator) ⇒ stronger
               commensurability ⇒ confirms the crystalline / no-arithmetic reading. PASS at >= 0.80.
    Conclusion: pin the criterion to SQUARED lengths; PASS iff >= 80% of squared-ratio pairs are rational

# ---- Conditional blocks ----

  backward: "FUTURE: a PASS may seed a cross-pillar §VII candidate (spectral-action monotonicity ↔ length-spectrum commensurability), registered in a LATER session — forward pointer only, NOT a W7 landing (no §VII entry lands this session)."

## Execution Notes (Wave 7)

- **Python**: `"phonon-exflation-sim/.venv312/Scripts/python.exe"` for every script (GPU-enabled venv; per `.claude/rules/computation-environment.md`).
- **GPU vs CPU dispatch**: W7-2 uses `torch.fft` (length-spectrum transform) + numpy for cache I/O; W7-5 uses torch for the Θ(t) heat-trace assembly over the cache, mpmath (CPU, arbitrary precision) for the Mellin continuation + zero search. W7-1/W7-3/W7-4/W7-6 are CPU-bounded (Sage MCP + mpmath; small symbolic/arbitrary-precision work) — cap `OMP_NUM_THREADS=8` before `import numpy`.
- **D_K block-diagonality**: no W7 gate diagonalizes D_K (the s84 cache is read READ-ONLY; W7-1 uses the closed |λ|²=C₂+c_off form, NO diagonalization). The L_max≥10 block-diagonality pre-check (`math-scripts.md`) is satisfied trivially — no new diagonalization is performed.
- **Sage MCP**: W7-1 (rank-2 Poisson summation derivation), W7-4 (PSLQ rational recovery) use `mcp__sage__sage_eval` / `sage_simplify`. Cite the Sage call in the producing script's `# (local)` provenance.
- **Output**: `computations/session-105/` (scripts `s105_w7_*.py`, npz, png). Script prefix `s105_`.
- **Verdict file**: `computations/session-105/s105_gate_verdicts.txt` (canonical path per `.claude/rules/gate-verdicts.md`; all other variants forbidden). Each gate's producing script prints the `print_verdict_payload`; the agent calls the `emit_verdict` knowledge-MCP tool (race-safe; never a raw `open("a")` append). W7-6's emission additionally carries the `# composite-precedence:` companion row.
- **Each gate writes results ONLY to its designated `### §W7-{i}.` section** in `sessions/session-105/session-105-w7-workingpaper.md`.
- **No TeamCreate** — all W7 gates are independent Agent-tool calls; intra-wave sequencing (W7-1 → W7-2 → {W7-3, W7-4}) is enforced by dispatch order + the gated-on-non-FAIL closure discipline.
- **`from canonical_constants import *`** at the top of every script (S34+ MANDATORY); never hardcode `tau_fold`, `PI`, `Vol_SU3_Haar`, `a_n_FW_zeta`. Tag every computed intermediate with `# (local)`.
